about: What watches the House from outside GitHub (WORKLIST P0.38; P3.7 adds the production checks). Each heartbeat is a Sentry cron monitor named by its slug, on the workflow's own schedule, which emails the owner when a check-in is late by margin_minutes. heartbeatsAreKept.test.ts holds every scheduled workflow to one heartbeat here, with the same schedule and a job that checks in.
